brand.name: Lamborghini
brand.tagline: Italian super sports car maker from Sant'Agata Bolognese, part of the Audi / Volkswagen Group
brand.description: Automobili Lamborghini is an Italian maker of super sports cars and SUVs, founded in 1963 and based in Sant'Agata Bolognese; it is owned by Audi within the Volkswagen Group. In India it sells imported cars through dealerships in New Delhi, Mumbai and Bengaluru. The current Indian line-up is all plug-in hybrid: Urus SE, Temerario and Revuelto.

models.name: Urus
models.engine: 3996 cc twin-turbo V8 + electric motor (plug-in hybrid)

items: 4.0-litre twin-turbo V8 with 141 kW electric motor integrated in the gearbox
8-speed automatic gearbox with torque converter
25.9 kWh lithium-ion traction battery
Four-wheel drive with torque-vectoring electronic rear differential
Carbon-ceramic brakes (440 mm front, 410 mm rear discs)
EV Drive, Hybrid, Recharge and Performance hybrid modes in addition to road, track and off-road modes
Air suspension with semi-active dampers and ride-height adjustment

12.3-inch central touchscreen

21-inch wheels standard (285/45 ZR21 front, 315/40 ZR21 rear); 22- and 23-inch wheels available

highlights: Plug-in hybrid: 4.0-litre twin-turbo V8 plus electric motor, 800 CV combined
25.9 kWh battery with a claimed electric-only range of 60 km
0–100 km/h in 3.4 s and 312 km/h top speed (claimed)
8-speed automatic, all-wheel drive, air suspension and rear-wheel steering
Replaced the Urus S and Urus Performante in India in August 2024

variants.name: Urus SE
features: 25.9 kWh battery, 60 km claimed electric range

models.notes: Price not published by the brand; from Autocar India (Delhi ex-showroom, before options). The figure is the Aug 2024 launch price still listed in Nov 2026; no Lamborghini revision after the Sept 2025 GST change was found, so confirm with a dealer. Urus SE is the only Urus sold in India; the Urus SE Performante (revealed July 2026) has no India launch yet and is not included. Combined torque (950 Nm), 60 km EV range and 12.3-inch screen are from Autocar India's launch report; lamborghini.com lists V8 800 Nm and e-motor 483 Nm. Seat count (5) from Autocar India. Fuel tank and boot are not on lamborghini.com and publications disagree (85/75 L tank, 454/616 L boot), so left null. Colours are Lamborghini's standard palette as listed by Autocar India; Ad Personam colours cost extra. No ARAI figure.

models.notes: Price not published by the brand; from Autocar India (Delhi ex-showroom, before options). One version is priced in India; the Alleggerita package is an option and not separately priced. The Temerario Spyder has no India launch and is not included. lamborghini.com publishes V8 torque only (730 Nm), no combined figure. Airbag count (4) is Lamborghini's 'driver, passenger, side airbags'; knee airbags exist only for some markets. Battery size and screen sizes are from Autocar Pro's launch report. Fuel tank and luggage capacity are not on the official page, so left null. Colours are Lamborghini's standard palette as listed by Autocar India; Ad Personam colours cost extra. No ARAI figure.
